Thank You Photographers
Thank you to photographers Dean Specker, Gale Matthews, and Luci Smith for generously sharing their photography for display on the county website and helping showcase the beauty and character of our community. Read on... about
Johnson County's Website Has Moved (and Gotten a Makeover)!
Johnson County's website has a brand-new look!
More information, easier navigation, and improved access to county services—all in one place. Read on... about
Bridge Construction: NE 500th Road over Walnut Creek
Bridge Construction Underway
Construction activities are in progress on the NE 500 Road bridge over Walnut Creek by Seymour Construction. View project updates on the Project Updates page. Additional Info... about
Passing of Western Commissioner Charlie Kavanaugh
Johnson County mourns Western Commissioner Charlie Kavanaugh, who served since 2017. A dedicated public servant, he helped strengthen county finances, reduce taxes, improve roads and bridges, and maintain balanced budgets. He will be deeply missed. Read on... about
